questions.q: Which phase comes first in a warm-up?
questions.why: A warm-up starts with a pulse raiser, then stretches, then skill practice.

questions.q: What does the 'C' in RICE stand for?
Which drug reduces anxiety and would help an archer?
questions.why: Beta blockers slow heart rate and reduce tremor, helping precision sports.

questions.q: Describe how blood doping is carried out and one side effect.
questions.model: Blood is removed and stored, then re-injected before competition to increase red blood cells. A side effect is thicker blood, which raises the risk of clots, heart attack or stroke.
points: blood removed/stored then re-injected (transfusion) to increase red blood cells
